entities.summary: Samandar Hamroqulov born 23 December 1978),is an Uzbek pop singer, actor, Honored Artist of Uzbekistan (2007). Samandar became famous in Uzbekistan in 2002 with the song "Sevgi fazosi". He sings in both Uzbek and Russian.
